# Jerry Corcoran

[Good-Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#good-conduct-club)

- **Gender:** male (since v5)  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P29](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0029)</sub>

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Jerry possesses large black eyes and black hair, which he inherited from his father.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P6](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0006)_

## Personality

Jerry Corcoran is known to pass the time playing the jew's-harp when tired of other games like leap frog. However, his skill on the instrument was eventually surpassed by another who learned to play it.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE P30](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0030)_

## History

Jerry Corcoran offered a political bribe to [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md), which was accidentally overheard by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). Later, as one of the Meredith children living at the manse, Jerry joined his siblings [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Una](../character/una-meredith.md), and [Carl](../character/carl.md) in forming the [Good-Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#good-conduct-club) alongside [Jem Blythe](../character/jem.md) to manage their behavior and avoid bringing dishonor to their father. When [Faith](../character/faith.md) attempted to catch a cold on a snowbank to avoid wearing ugly stockings to church, Jerry and [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) forcibly pulled her off. After [Faith](../character/faith.md) caused a scandal by attending church without stockings, Jerry enforced a [Good-Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#good-conduct-club) punishment requiring her to wear the hated pair. Jerry later assigned a club punishment to [Carl](../character/carl.md) for cowardice, ordering him to sit in the graveyard until midnight; though [Carl](../character/carl.md) completed the task, he contracted severe pneumonia as a result before eventually recovering.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P58](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0058), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P61](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0061), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P66](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0066), [v5 CHAPTER XXIII. THE GOOD-CONDUCT CLUB P3](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0003), [v5 CHAPTER XXIII. THE GOOD-CONDUCT CLUB P33](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0033), +14 more_

## Relationships

### [Jem](../character/jem.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/jem--jerry-corcoran.md)

Jerry and [Jem](../character/jem.md) are close friends who frequently spend time together alongside their siblings in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), playing games like quoits. [Jem](../character/jem.md) acts as an advisor to Jerry and the Meredith children, suggesting the creation of the [Good-Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#good-conduct-club) to help them manage their own behavior and protect their father's reputation. Jerry adopts this idea, participating in the club's self-enforced rules and helping issue punishments when members cause local scandals.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P37](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0037), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P45](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0045), +10 more_

- Friend of — playmates playing quoits together in Rainbow Valley (since v5)  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER VIII. MISS CORNELIA INTERVENES P12](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0012)</sub>
